sections.text_helper: Section 35.9.11 "TIM auto-reautoreload register (TIM_ARR)" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1465.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x2C
Reset value: 0x0000FFFF
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:0 ARR[19:0]: Auto-reload value
ARR is the value to be loaded in the actual auto-reload register.
Refer to the Section35.5.3: Time-base unit on page1341 for more details about ARR
update and behavior.
The counter is blocked while the auto-reload value is null.
Non-dithering mode (DITHEN = 0)
The register holds the auto-reload value in ARR[15:0]. The ARR[19:16] bits are reset.
Dithering mode (DITHEN = 1)
The register holds the integer part in ARR[19:4]. The ARR[3:0] bitfield contains the dithered
part.
